slides.title:
Postdoc or industry?
Ask 3 questions first.
slides.body: Decide on purpose, not by default.
slides.say: Thinking about a postdoc before industry? Don't take one by default. Ask these three questions first.

slides.title: What job do I want after this?
slides.body: Name the title. If you can't, informational interviews are a cheaper way to find out.
slides.say: Question one. What job do I want after this? Name the title. If you can't, informational interviews are a cheaper way to find out.

slides.title: Do postings for that job ask for one?
slides.body: Check ten real postings. Data science, consulting and regulatory roles often hire PhDs directly.
slides.say: Question two. Do job postings for that role ask for a postdoc? Check ten real ones. Data science, consulting, and regulatory roles often hire P H Ds directly.

slides.title: What will I have at the end?
slides.after: A new technique, a new field, or industry contacts.
slides.say: Question three. What will I have at the end that I don't have now? Not, more papers. Instead, a new technique, a new field, or industry contacts.

slides.title: Should you do a postdoc first?
slides.body: When it helps, when to skip it, 5 questions. Link in the description.
slides.say: Want all five questions, and when a postdoc really helps? Read the free guide. Link in the description.
